posts.label: Market Update
posts.alt: Scottsdale market update post: fewer contracts, prices still up
posts.caption: Fewer contracts in Scottsdale, but prices are still up. In October the median single family home sold for $1,225,000, up 5.6% from a year ago, while pending sales fell 43.5% from a year ago, to 208. Fewer homes went under contract, but the median price held its gains. Source: Phoenix REALTORS, ARMLS data, October 2026. #ScottsdaleAZ #ScottsdaleRealEstate
